_comment: Named the OPPONENT under 'target', which the handler does not read, so it fell back to the CONTROLLER. 'THEY discard a card' -- so the caster was discarding their own. Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
